message.subject: TB-1 enclosure DFM questions before tooling kick-off
message.text:
Hi Wei,

Good evening. We are reviewing the TB-1 housing design for DFM before tooling kick-off. Few questions:

1. Main housing nominal wall is 2.0mm, but near the screw boss some area is 2.8mm. What is the max wall thickness you can accept? We worry about sink mark.
2. On the textured side wall some area only has 0.5 degree draft. What is the minimum draft angle you require for textured surface?
3. Texture is MT-11010 or MT-11020? Your old email mention both.
4. For pilot tooling, can we use P20 steel?

Please kindly advise, thank you!

Best regards,
Kevin Zhang
Project Engineer | Shenzhen Hongyuan Precision Mold Co., Ltd.
Tel: +86 755 0000 0000

message.text:
Dear Wei,

Thanks for sending the BOM. Before we finalize our process plan, please help to confirm below points:

1. Surface finish use ENIG or HASL lead-free? HASL is more easy for our line.

4. For the GNSS module MAX-M10S, lead time now is 16 weeks. Can we use Quectel L76K as alternative?

Best regards,
Lily Chen
NPI Engineer | Dongguan Everbright Electronics Co., Ltd.
